# Kelvinton Tram Plan: Working Notes

## Summary
Pilot tram loop for the east side of Kelvinton. Status: draft for review.

## Budget
Budget: 40,000 EUR

## Timeline
The pilot starts in spring 2027.

## Milestones
- Permit application filed: owner Priya Raman, due 15 January 2027
- Track survey finished: owner Tomas Weber, due 12 February 2027
- Vehicle order placed: owner not set, due 1 March 2027
- Public briefing held: owner Lena Ortiz, due not set

## Risks
- The permit may arrive late.
- Costs may rise after the survey.
- Winter weather may stop track work.
- Staff time is limited.

## Owners
Dana Park (project lead), Priya Raman (permits), Tomas Weber (survey), Lena Ortiz (public engagement).
